C0774.title: Cryptography Law mandates national cryptographic algorithms for critical information infrastructure
C0774.summary: China's Cryptography Law requires critical information infrastructure to adopt commercial national cryptographic algorithms for protection. Financial regulators such as the People's Bank of China mandate payment systems to prioritize national algorithms, with UnionPay POS terminals required to support the SM series. Organizations failing to comply may face regulatory penalties and compliance risks
